title: CI perf basin anchoring & rolling gates for tokens/sec + p95 regression detection
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Add a production-grounded, low-noise CI gating layer that detects continuous performance regressions for tokens/sec and p95 and reduces false positives by anchoring baselines to stable 'basins' and using rolling gate logic. Current CI baseline approach is brittle: single-run baselines or long static windows cause flapping and either miss regressions or over-block PRs. This ticket designs and implements a basin-anchoring + rolling-gate system that produces actionable PR signals and ties into existing baseline reconciliation and dashboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline chooser selects an anchor window automatically by clustering recent N baseline runs into basins and picking the most stable basin (min variance) for comparison.
CI gating produces a soft-warning on minor deviations and a hard-block only when multi-signal conditions are met (see gating rules).
Regression decisions require at least two independent signals across metric lanes (tokens/sec p95 and tokens/sec mean or shadow runs) to reduce single-metric false positives.

End-to-end integration: PRs run fast lightweight shadow runs in CI; failing PRs trigger a full replay baseline job and post detailed diff artifact to the PR with p95/tokens/sec distributions and raw traces.
False positive rate on historical replayed PRs remains below 3% after tuning (measured against last six months of perf PRs).
Dashboard exposes anchor basin selection, rolling gate state, and historic test windows for every gated PR.
implementation_plan: 1) Data collection: extend perf-harness to tag run metadata, sequence-length histogram, KV-cache-hit ratios, and tokens/sec traces (existing telemetry extension).
2) Basin selection service: offline algorithm (k-means on summary stats + variance scoring) to group recent baselines into basins; expose API returning chosen anchor window id.
3) Statistical engine: implement EWMA + CUSUM detectors and non-parametric bootstrap on p95 to estimate CI for comparison; wrap in a small service used by CI gate step.

4) CI integration: add a lightweight shadow run step to PR pipeline that runs a stratified sample of traffic (short/medium/long sequences) and posts metrics to the statistical engine; if soft-warning, enqueue a full replay job to the perf cluster.

5) Gating policy: soft-warning threshold at 5% tokens/sec drop or 10% p95 increase with p < 0.05; hard-block requires either: (a) both tokens/sec and p95 exceed thresholds, or (b) one metric exceeds 20% with p < 0.01 AND full replay confirms regression.
6) UI + artifacts: perf diff artifact with distribution plots, raw traces link, and recommended rollback command if blocked.
7) Run a 2-week shadow roll where gates only send notifications, tune thresholds to meet <3% FPR, then flip to blocking mode for P1 changes.
progress_updates: 2025-01-16: Initial spike complete. Prototyped basin clustering on last 30 baseline runs; k=3 gives coherent basins corresponding to weekday/weekend and infra-garbage-collection windows.
2025-01-20: Design review with SRE and Platform (notes: need sample weighting by sequence length and by KV-cache hit rate to avoid bias).
2025-01-24: Built lightweight shadow-run job; initial runs show high variance for long-sequence traces — adding stratified sampling to address sample imbalance.
2025-01-28: Prototype statistical engine integrated into CI runner. EWMA+CUSUM produces fewer flickers than single-run deltas. Found two historical PRs that would have been blocked correctly.
2025-02-01: Tuning session with data-science: adjusted bootstrap sample size and introduced multi-lane confirmation rule to reduce false positives. Plan shadow roll for 2 weeks starting 2025-02-05.
2025-02-03: Opened GH PR #3821 adding basin selector and CI hook. CI tests green on small runner. Requesting review from @olivia and @sre-team.
notes_for_reviewers: Focus on the basin selection heuristics — we prioritized variance minimization but added business rules to avoid selecting small sample basins (<6 runs).
Review the gating thresholds and confirm they align with SLA targets (SRE requested p95 SLO margin of 15%).
Look at the stratified sampling strategy for long-sequence traces; currently we cap long-seq samples to 10% of the shadow run to keep job time bounded.
risks: Risk: Infrastructure noise (node-level maintenance) can bias basin selection. Mitigation: annotate runs with infra events and exclude runs with maintenance tags.
Risk: Shadow runs might not reproduce edge-case cache patterns. Mitigation: full replay path required for hard-blocks and include synthetic KV-warmup profiles.
Risk: Additional CI time. Mitigation: lightweight shadow step runs on small fleet; full replays scheduled asynchronously and only run when soft-warning triggers.
